name: Stanford Alpaca
description: An instruction-following dataset of 52,002 instruction, input, and response examples generated with OpenAI's text-davinci-003 model using self-instruct. The examples were created to fine-tune LLaMA models.
citation: Taori, R., Gulrajani, I., Zhang, T., Dubois, Y., Li, X., Guestrin, C., Liang, P., and Hashimoto, T. B. (2023). Stanford Alpaca: An Instruction-following LLaMA Model. https://github.com/tatsu-lab/stanford_alpaca

license.notes: The upstream project states that the dataset is released under CC BY-NC 4.0, a standard SPDX identifier. The generated responses are based on outputs from OpenAI's text-davinci-003; review applicable third-party terms and restrictions before use or redistribution.
